description:
Note on travelling: While this is a remote-first role for candidates based in Europe, we may occasionally ask you to visit our facility in Mārupe, Latvia for work-related activities. We always plan these in advance and keep them flexible.


About the team:

The Inventory Management team builds the internal systems that enable procurement of goods/materials used for production, physical handling of said goods (warehouse system), as well as production equipment maintenance management. Each of the shipments coming out of our facilities has been made possible in part thanks to the solutions developed and maintained by our team. Our team’s ultimate goal is to ensure that there’s always enough inventory and the amount of human resources needed for inventory management is as low as reasonably attainable.

Domain Areas You'll Work On:

  • Integrations with our suppliers

  • Purchase order generation and processing

  • Warehouse management and process optimization

  • Internal and external observability of stock levels and projections

  • Hardware maintenance management

About the Role:

As a Staff Full Stack Engineer, you'll be driving the technical vision for the production and workforce tools our facilities depend on. Your work will directly impact how fast, accurately, and efficiently we turn orders into shipped products.


Your daily tasks will include:

  • Design and implement backend systems for inventory procurement, warehouse management, and equipment maintenance management

  • Develop frontend interfaces and data visualisations for operators and managers

  • Analyze the effectiveness of current processes and help improve them

  • Collaborate closely with product managers, operations teams, and other engineers to iterate on feature development

  • Take ownership of initiatives, from concept to delivery

  • Maintain and improve the quality of our codebase through testing, refactoring, and code reviews

  • Share knowledge in team and cross-team meetups

  • Support continuous improvement of our tools and architecture


Your qualifications:

  • Strong backend development experience

  • Experience with DDD (Domain-Driven Design)

  • Experience with performance optimization

  • Familiarity with distributed systems and message queues

  • Strong understanding of clean code, testing, and Agile practices

  • Ability to work independently and drive results in a fast-paced environment

  • Comfortable collaborating in English (spoken & written)

  • We believe in collaboration, and from time to time, this role may involve short visits to our facility in Mārupe for team events or operational needs.


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Python, Rust, PHP, or Go

  • Experience with CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation)

  • Experience building internal platforms (ERP, OMS, WMS, or similar) in manufacturing, logistics, or supply chain environments

  • Experience integrating software with hardware such as scanners, printers, IoT, or automation equipment

  • "You build it, you run it" mindset (Experience hosting 12 factor applications, "Infrastructure as code", familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker)

Our tech stack:

  • Backend: PHP (Laravel, Yii, Symfony), PhpUnit, static code analysis tools

  • Frontend: Vue.js, TypeScript

  • Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis

  • Infra: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, Atlantis

  • Engineering Tools: Postman, Git, GitHub Copilot, PhpStorm, Grafana, Kibana, Prometheus.

  • Remote work Tools: Jira, Miro, Google Workspace, Slack.

  • Development Practices: Pair Programming, Code Reviews, Continuous Integration/Deployment.


What we offer:

  • An opportunity to work remotely or in a modern and welcoming office in Riga

  • A global, inclusive team that’s as supportive as it is ambitious and serious about getting things done

  • Flexible working hours (start your day as late as 11 AM)

  • Private health insurance

  • 2 extra paid days off to focus on your mental or physical well-being

  • 1 extra paid day off to celebrate a Birthday or any other celebration of your choice

  • Internal and external learning opportunities

  • Access to mentorship, internal meetups, and hackathons, both on-site and online

  • Free and healthy lunch if you work from the Rīga office

  • Design and order your own merch using our platforms with an employee discount

  • Exciting team-building events and parties you’ll never forget!


FYUL is the engine that powers on-demand commerce at global scale.

Formed in 2024 through the merger of Printful, Printify, and Snow Commerce, we bring together tech, talent, and infrastructure to help people turn ideas into beautiful products.

From solo creators to entertainment giants, FYUL powers merch that connects with millions, backed by advanced tech, premium production, and global reach.

We're a fast-growing global company working toward powering great brands, great experiences, and great people.

We are an equal-opportunity workplace. We’re committed to diversity and inclusion and make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and work experience.

If you think you’d excel in this role, send us your resume in English, showing us why you are the right person for the job.

Interested, but don’t think this is the right fit for you? Feel free to share it with friends and check out other open positions at our career site. We’re always looking for creative and driven minds to join our ever-growing team!
